description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the Botanical Garden, 1 Kodre se samilit street, above the tunnel. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a building with an elevator. It is organized in a common living room + kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony.
